definitionZh: 确认编辑组件允许用户在提交更改之前验证更改 - 防止意外编辑或在保存之前取消编辑。
sourceDefinition: The confirm edit component lets users verify changes before they are committed — preventing accidental edits or letting them cancel before saving.
